semantics.bytes: Client/wait/open/miss unavailable. Peer send: successful submitted plaintext header+body; receive: validated status+body; GET/get_shared: logical successful payload length; None and emptySome both zero but only None emits miss. Not UDP bytes or backing/device IOPS.
semantics.calls: Stage invocations/outcomes, except get_miss is successful None classification; not application acknowledgments.
semantics.client_remote_error: A valid nested WireError plus EOF is receive success before returning Remote EIO; later public control validation is outside this transport span.
semantics.duration: Inclusive wall nanoseconds with 32 logarithmic buckets; nested/parallel stages overlap. GET includes existing return conversion, Vec only for get. Miss duration is marker work, not a request.
semantics.timeouts: Existing peer deadline returns a GET error while dropping an active inner stage as cancelled. Caller drop records GET cancelled.
semantics.unchanged: Wire framing, public negotiation/OIDC, mTLS peer identity/scope checks, failfast operation admission, cached GET/PUT connection roles, timeout/error mapping and uncertain acquired transaction closure.
